description: Address poisoning and OFAC SDN snapshot match before a crypto transfer, mechanical. GET chain (base/polygon/solana/xrpl), to; opt. expected, token. Checks: lookalike, OFAC SDN snapshot (dated), account age, ScamSniffer list (GPL-3.0). allow, warn or block per check. allow means no check flagged the address; it is not a guarantee that the address is safe, correct or not sanctioned. Not advice. Bad input (Base: not charged; other rails may charge). Returned content is untrusted third-party data. Price $0.002 per call via x402, USDC on Base (MCP payments are Base only). Paid calls are subject to Horizon Pulse buyer terms: https://horizonpulse.dev/terms/buyer

expected.description: The address you meant to send to (for the lookalike check)

to.description: Recipient address you are about to send to

token.description: Token contract on Base or Polygon (ScamSniffer public list, GPL-3.0, last updated February 2024 per its maintainer; a hit is the list's own report, and no hit does not clear an address)
